grilled_fish.name: Grilled Fish
grilled_fish.description: Crisp skin, flaky flesh. Stamina recovers faster for a while.

venison_roast.name: Venison Roast
venison_roast.description: A slow-roasted haunch. Filling, and puts strength in your arm.

berry_pie.name: Berry Pie
berry_pie.description: Wild berries under a bread crust. You walk a little lighter.

mushroom_soup.name: Mushroom Soup
mushroom_soup.description: Earthy broth with a healing herb. Toughens you against harm.

healing_salve.name: Healing Salve
healing_salve.description: Herb paste in a tin. Closes wounds far better than raw leaves.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: Bitter tincture. Cures a festering bite.

stamina_draught.name: Stamina Draught
stamina_draught.description: Tart berry cordial. Stamina floods back for two hours.

iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.description: Rust-streaked rock. Smelt two with coal at an anvil forge.

coal.name: Lump of Coal
coal.description: Burns hot enough to smelt ore.

iron_ingot.name: Iron Ingot
iron_ingot.description: Smelted iron, ready for the anvil.

copper_ingot.name: Copper Ingot
copper_ingot.description: Soft, bright metal for fittings and rings.

leather.name: Tanned Leather
leather.description: A cured hide, supple and strong.

log.name: Log
log.description: A felled trunk, trimmed and ready to haul.

stone.name: Quarry Stone
stone.description: Rough stone prised from the rock. Dress it at a mason's bench.

cut_stone.name: Cut Stone
cut_stone.description: Squared blocks for walls that last.

clay.name: Clay
clay.description: Wet, heavy and good for daub.

thatch.name: Thatch
thatch.description: Bundled reeds and straw for a roof.

arrowheads.name: Iron Arrowheads
arrowheads.description: Barbed tips for arrows. Fletchers pay well.

horseshoe.name: Horseshoe
horseshoe.description: Every stable in the realm needs these.

saddle.name: Riding Saddle
saddle.description: Leather over a wooden tree. For a horse of your own.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.description: An honest arming sword with a leather grip.

iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
iron_helm.description: Riveted skullcap with a nasal bar.

copper_ring.name: Copper Ring
copper_ring.description: Plain band. Some say copper keeps you light on your feet.

belt_pouch.name: Belt Pouch
belt_pouch.description: Keeps the little things to hand.

hammer.name: Smith's Hammer
hammer.description: Carry one and your smithing improves faster.

wood_axe.name: Wood Axe
wood_axe.description: Fells trees. Bites into wolves too.

pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
pickaxe.description: Carry one and ore veins give more.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.description: Grain from your own field. Millers pay for it, or grind it yourself.

barley.name: Barley
barley.description: Hardy grain. Brewers and bakers both want it.

turnip.name: Turnip
turnip.description: A root that shrugs off frost. Winter's dependable crop.

flax.name: Flax
flax.description: Fibrous stalks. Weavers spin it into linen cloth.

flour.name: Sack of Flour
flour.description: Wheat ground fine at the mill. Bakers pay well for it.

pork.name: Pork
pork.description: A cut from your own sty.

wool.name: Raw Wool
wool.description: Sheared and bagged, ready for a weaver.

hides.name: Raw Hides
hides.description: Untanned hides from village livestock. The tannery wants these.

cloth.name: Bolt of Cloth
cloth.description: Woven wool, dyed and bolted for tailors.

ale.name: Cask of Ale
ale.description: A small cask, tapped by the cup.

tools.name: Iron Tools
tools.description: Hoes, sickles and hammers, bundled for sale.

luxury_goods.name: Luxury Goods
luxury_goods.description: Silks, spices and fine glassware fit for a noble's table.

weapons.name: Crate of Weapons
weapons.description: Spears and blades bundled for a garrison, not a single fighter.

horses.name: Horse
horses.description: A sound cart or riding horse.
